prompt: Our controller wants a one-pager on why the effective tax rate jumped this year. Using the ETR_Rec tab of the attached Tax_Provision_FY26.xlsx, explain the three reconciling items that moved the rate most between FY2025 and FY2026, one short paragraph each with the basis-point impact. If a driver isn't visible in the tab, say that rather than filling the gap.

for the quarter-end JE review: in the selected journal entry listing, flag manual entries over $250,000 with round-dollar amounts posted in the final three days of Q3. give me entry number, preparer, amount, posting date and account. just list them, don't judge whether any of them are improper.

We're rebuilding the reporting chart of accounts mapping ahead of the 10-K. Map every account in the attached TB_Oct2026.xlsx to a balance sheet or income statement line from the FS_Lines tab. Return account number, account name and mapped line. Where an account could fit two lines, mark it 'review' and show both options instead of picking one.

In the AR_Aging sheet of the attached Receivables_Q3.xlsx, I need a formula for column J that calculates days sales outstanding per customer from the open balance in column E and trailing 90-day sales in column G. It's for the credit team's weekly dashboard. Give the formula for row 2 with one line on how it works, and test it on a customer with $45,000 open and $135,000 of sales, which should come out at 30 days.
For our new VP of Tax: summarize the selected transfer pricing memo section in four bullets, under 90 words. Quote percentages and ranges word for word.

Tighten the allowance for credit losses paragraph in the critical accounting estimates section of this document. It's going in the 10-Q and reviewers said it reads as repetitive. Cut it to roughly 120 words, active voice. The meaning, the loss rates and the sensitivity figure can't change, and if something has to go, tell me what you removed.

I'm training two new seniors on the intercompany reconciliation for month-end. Turn the attached IC_Recon_Procedure.docx into a numbered checklist of at most 12 steps, each starting with a verb and naming the report or tab it uses. Stay within what the procedure says, and mark any step you had to infer with (inferred).

Can you compare the liquidity and capital resources section of our draft Q3 10-Q (attached) with the same section of the Q2 10-Q, also attached? The disclosure committee wants to see what changed. Table: topic, Q2 wording, Q3 wording, nature of change. Only real changes, not formatting, and cite the page number for each one.

I'm doing the walkthrough of the treasury wire transfer approval control next Tuesday with the AP manager. From the Wire Transfers row of the attached RCM_Treasury_2026.xlsx, write seven questions to confirm the control is designed properly, ordered from initiation to release. After each question, note which attribute of the control description it tests so I can trace it back to the RCM.

Rewrite the draft finding in the selected text so it follows condition, criteria, cause, effect, with a one-line heading for each. It goes to the IT director, so keep it factual and non-blaming, under 200 words. Nothing new should appear that isn't already in the draft; if one of the four parts has nothing behind it, keep the heading and write 'not documented'.

Before the Q3 testing package goes to the external auditors, check that every control ID in the Testing_Summary tab matches a control in the attached RCM_2026_v4.xlsx with the same frequency. Mismatches only, in a table: control ID, frequency in summary, frequency in RCM. Show both values side by side; I'll decide which one is right.

The CISO wants our vendor security questionnaire lined up against NIST CSF 2.0. Assign each question in the attached Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx to one CSF function (Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover). Columns: question number, question, function, one-line reason. If a question doesn't clearly belong anywhere, put 'unclear' rather than forcing a fit.

Draft a new enterprise risk register entry on single-supplier dependency for our packaging inputs, based on the procurement notes in this document. The ERM committee reads these, so use the register layout: risk title, description (max 60 words), likely causes, potential impact. Use only what the notes support and list your assumptions at the end.

A payroll control owner keeps asking me what complementary user entity controls are. Using section 5 of the payroll provider's SOC 1 Type 2 report (attached), explain in under 120 words, with no audit jargon, what CUECs are and why they matter for us, using one example taken from that section. If the report doesn't list any, tell me that instead.

For the audit committee's annual risk refresh: using the selected rows of the 2026 Risk Assessment sheet, identify the five risks whose residual score changed most since the 2025 column. Rank by size of change, one line each with old score, new score and the reason in the comments column. Where the comments cell is empty, write 'no reason recorded' rather than supplying one.

Pull every open audit issue that is past its due date from the attached Issue_Tracker_Oct2026.xlsx for the CAE's monthly report: issue ID, owner, original due date, days overdue, severity. Sort by days overdue, highest first. Take dates exactly as entered and flag any row where the due date cell is blank.

Our assurance provider starts fieldwork in three weeks. In the Waste tab of the attached Waste_Data_FY2025.xlsx, find any site-month where recycled tonnes are higher than total waste tonnes. Table: site, month, total t, recycled t, cell reference. Don't correct the figures, just point me to them.

For the RE100 progress update to the board, extract every renewable electricity contract from the selected rows of the energy procurement register: site, supplier, contract type (PPA, green tariff or unbundled certificates), annual MWh, end date. One row per contract. If the contract type isn't stated, leave it blank and don't infer it from the supplier name.

need a formula for column F in the NatGas sheet of the attached Stationary_Combustion_2025.xlsx that converts the kWh in column C to tCO2e using the emission factor (kg CO2e per kWh) in cell B1. it feeds our Scope 1 total for the CDP response. give it for F2 so i can fill down, and a sanity check: 50,000 kWh at 0.183 should return 9.15 tCO2e.

Legal flagged the net-zero paragraph in this document as too absolute for the annual report. Rewrite it in no more than 80 words so each claim matches what our transition plan actually commits to (a 2030 interim target and net zero by 2045). Leave the targets and base year untouched and add no new commitments.

We're collecting Scope 3 Category 6 business travel data from our travel agency for the first time. Based on the methodology section of the attached GHG_Inventory_Manual.docx, write a checklist of the data fields to request from the agency, max 10 items, grouped under air, rail and hotel. Include only what the manual calls for and point to the paragraph each item comes from.

The sustainability steering group wants to see how our material topics moved. Compare the 2024 and 2025 double materiality results in the attached DMA_Results.xlsx (one tab per year) and list the topics that were added, dropped or crossed the materiality threshold. Table: topic, 2024 status, 2025 status. Base it only on the scores in the file, no commentary on why.

Draft the methodology note for Scope 3 Category 4 upstream transportation in our FY2025 GHG inventory report, using the calculation approach described in the selected text. The reader is the limited assurance reviewer, so one paragraph of 150 words or less covering data sources, emission factors and the spend-based fallback. Mark anything the selected text doesn't state as [to confirm].

Our renewable energy certificate claims are in scope for assurance this year. Using the attached REC_Claims_Memo_2025.pdf, write six numbered questions the assurance team is likely to raise about how we matched certificates to consumption. Ground each question in a specific statement from the memo and quote that statement in brackets after it.

Summarize the attached ERP_Migration_Retrospective.docx for the PMO lead who missed the session. Three short sections (what went well, what didn't, open actions), 150 words total. Keep the team's phrasing, and leave out any opinion the retrospective itself doesn't contain.

Draft a welcome note for an analyst joining our FP&A team on Monday, using the first-week schedule in the attached Onboarding_Plan.docx. Warm but short, under 120 words, written from me as their manager. Keep the meeting days and times exactly as the plan shows them.

In the Headcount tab of the attached Org_Data.xlsx I need an XLOOKUP for column D that pulls the cost center owner from the Owners tab using the code in column B. HR uses this sheet for the quarterly org review. It should return 'No owner' when the code isn't found. Show the formula for D2 and give me one test case to check it before I fill it down.

A new coordinator on my team is taking over document routing. Using the approval workflow steps in the attached Doc_Routing_SOP.pdf, explain in plain language how a document moves from draft to final sign-off, in under 150 words. Stick to what the SOP says and point out any step where it's unclear who approves.

Check that the milestone dates on slide 6 of the attached Program_Update_Oct.pptx match Project_Plan_v7.xlsx before Thursday's steering committee. Mismatches only, as a table; don't pick which date is right.

For the finance ops weekly check, find expense claims in the attached Expense_Claims_Sept.xlsx that look like they were submitted twice: same employee, same amount, same date.
